content.title: Applications & Forms for Permits in Woodinville
content.summary: The City of Woodinville Development Services Department accepts most permit applications online through their Permit Portal. Applicants can submit applications, pay fees, schedule inspections, and track projects via the portal. PDF versions of various permit applications and forms are also available for download.

steps.title: Access the Permit Portal
steps.text: Visit the City of Woodinville's online Permit Portal to submit permit applications, revisions, pay fees, schedule inspections, and track your project.

steps.title: Download PDF Forms
steps.text: If you prefer, download PDF versions of permit applications and forms from the City of Woodinville website for various permit types including Building, Fire, Home Business, Land Use, Signs, Site Development, Special Events, Right-of-Way, Tree Removal, and Bonds/Financial Guarantees.
